model.name: R19.47: Identical file content reuses the existing FileUnit UUID and adds another unitLink.
model.description: When a user drops a file whose content hash (R19.49) matches an EXISTING FileUnit in the index, the system MUST NOT create a new UUID/scenario unit. Instead it reuses the existing FileUnit's UUID and adds another unitLink (symlink) from the new location to that existing unit. The Room.files[] IOR list (R19.46) is not duplicated — the existing IOR is already there. This is content-addressable dedup: same content = same unit, multiple symlinks.
model.tronQuote: > TRON: "if the user dropped the same file twice and its identical to an existing content file, then register it NOT as a new UUID, but as the existing UUID and as another unitLink."
model.crossRefNote: R19.49 (content hash) provides the match key. R19.46 (Room.files[] IOR dedup) ensures the room doesn't double-list the file.
